name: less-admin-hq
description: Free plugins from Less Admin HQ that help small business owners hand admin work to AI.

plugins.name: pay-nudger
plugins.description: Writes late-payment reminders: a short text and email in a friendly, firm, or final tone.

plugins.name: follow-up-writer
plugins.description: Follows up on quotes that went quiet, with a real reason to reply. Stops at three messages.

plugins.name: estimate-builder
plugins.description: Turns rough job notes into a clean written estimate. The owner sets every price.

plugins.name: invoice-matcher
plugins.description: Matches bank deposits to open invoices: paid, unpaid, and needs a look.

plugins.name: review-replier
plugins.description: Writes replies to Google reviews that name one specific thing. Never invents details.

plugins.name: post-job-summary
plugins.description: Turns rough job notes into a one-page summary for the customer. Never invents work or warranty terms.

plugins.name: deposit-requester
plugins.description: Writes the deposit request and the booking confirmation. The owner sets every amount and term.

plugins.name: post-call-confirmer
plugins.description: Turns call notes into a short confirmation of what was agreed. Flags loose ends instead of guessing.

plugins.name: timesheet-prep
plugins.description: Turns messy hours into totals per person. Flags missing times instead of guessing.

plugins.name: morning-due-check
plugins.description: Turns your open invoices and estimates into one short list of what needs attention today.
